title: West radius-two shoulder grids are omitted

impact.description: Native C marks 19 distinct grids versus 21 after correction; no meaningful gameplay outcome established.

notes: Duplicate light-list entries are a separate symptom; avoid claiming two missing flags saved a life.

references.description: reported C observation; not an independent validation

reference.description: reported C observation; not an independent validation

reported_sources.text:
The "East" block lights (y, x+2), (y+1, x+2), (y-1, x+2), but the "West"
  block lights (y, x-2), (y+2, x-2), (y-2, x-2) instead of (y+1, x-2) and
  (y-1, x-2). So (y+-1, x-2) never get `BORG_LIGHT`, and (y+-2, x-2) can be
  added a second time to `borg_light_x/y` (already added by the South/North
  blocks), contrary to the macro's comment. Also, with radius 4+ the four
  (y+-3, x+-3) grids can be entered twice (once by the diagonal checks and
  once by the box scan). Duplicates only make readers of the array
  (`borg_flow_dark`, `borg_update`) visit a grid twice.

verification_sources.kind: Mandos native C flag observation; practical impact unproven

next_at_import: Retain a legal/reachable normal-rule scenario, initialization/pins, actual before/after commands/outcomes and negative controls before marking a fix validated.
